idevice 0.1.68 is vendored from crates.io. Local changes use HTTPS for Apple TSS requests in src/tss.rs and preserve installation error name, numeric detail and reason in src/services/installation_proxy.rs, with parser regression tests. Cargo metadata and .cargo_vcs_info.json retain upstream provenance. Keep these patches when updating. The original MIT license and NOTICE-INSTALLATION-DIAGNOSTICS.txt are included.
